placement.candidate_window: The gate examines every candidate already returned by the checksum-verified exact same-locale retriever, whose maximum remains five. It neither enlarges that retrieval contract nor invokes ordinary search.
placement.terminal: If candidates existed but none satisfies every explicit request constraint, return assistant_relevance_no_matching_evidence before EvidencePack, worker, external evidence, source rendering or extractive fallback.

dimensions.rule: Every explicit constraint present in the question must agree with the candidate. Absence of a supported constraint in a candidate rejects that candidate; matching one broad term cannot override a conflicting platform, release, role, identifier, version or locale.

normalization.method: Unicode NFKC, case-folding and whitespace normalization; locale-aware stop words and topic markers are used only for deterministic comparison.
normalization.identifier_rule: Stable technical identifiers are matched against retained identifier metadata and reviewed text only; user-supplied identifiers never become paths, URLs, code or executable input.
normalization.locale_rule: A retrieval-result locale mismatch is terminal. The gate does not translate, merge or retry another locale.

regressions.ubuntu: For `Как установить BPM на Ubuntu?` and six locale equivalents, a published same-locale Ubuntu 26.04 installation candidate remains eligible and is cited. Debian 13.5 is incompatible even with a higher vector score and cannot reach model evidence or a source list.
regressions.general: Fixtures cover topic, stable identifier, operating system/distribution, release, reader role, BPM version and locale conflict. An unsupported request clarifies or abstains rather than silently substituting a different context.
